name: show
description: Show the person something on their screen, beside your text answer: a list of blocks, each a component of the screen with its properties, drawn one under the other (at most 16). Use it when an arrangement says it better than text: a table or cards, a diagram, a diff, a picture of a file you shared (an `Image` block names its sha256, which `share_file` returns). A file to keep goes with `share_file`, and a short answer stays in your text. Never use it to ask the person something: a `Choices` form drawn here has nobody to answer it, so `show` refuses it. Ask with `ask_user`, which takes `choices`. Call `ui_catalog` first; a block that breaks a component's schema is refused with the reason, and you can correct it. The result is "Shown to the person.", and you still answer in text. Example: {"blocks": [{"component": "Callout", "tone": "warning", "title": "Two tests fail", "text": "Both are in the parser."}]}
